bio: Stephen Chin is VP of Developer Relations at Neo4j, AAIF ambassador, program chair and board member for the LF AI & Data Foundation, and author of numerous titles including the upcoming GraphRAG: The Definitive Guide for O'Reilly. He has given keynotes at numerous conferences around the world including AI Engineer World’s Fair, The AI Conference, AI DevSummit, Open Source Summit, Devoxx, Jfokus, DevNexus, JNation, JavaOne, Shift, Joker, swampUP, and GIDS. Stephen is an avid motorcyclist who has done evangelism tours in Europe, Japan, and Brazil, interviewing developers in their natural habitat. When he is not traveling, he enjoys teaching kids how to do AI, embedded, and robot programming together with his daughters.
